title: SYNTHESIS, CHARACTERISATION, AND INVESTIGATION OF THERMAL AND ELECTROCHEMICAL PROPERTIES OF A NOVEL SALICYLAMIDE COORDINATED HIGH VALENT COBALT COMPOUND
abstract: A novel dimeric Cobalt compound, [CoIII(L)(µ-OH)]2. H2O of ligand 1,3-propylene-bis(salicylamide) (H2L) has been synthesized. XRD, FTIR and 1H NMR were used to elucidate the structure of the complex. Elemental analysis (CHNS) and TGA were employed to find out the composition. Thermal analysis shows that the average specific heat capacity (Cp) of the complex is 1.86 J/gK. The redox potential of the complex has been established by cyclovoltammetry and it shows a quasi-reversible nature of the Co3+/Co2+ couple. The optical bandgap (Eg) and refractive index of the complex were found to be 2.31 eV and 2.6 respectively. Thermal analysis revealed the thermal stability of the complex.
